verdict.rationale: Tavily's own docs describe an `include_domains` search filter with a "restrict" mode that keeps a hard filter to the listed domains, plus a "prefer" mode that lets other results still surface, so restricting results to specific domains is directly documented. Nothing in the pack documents excluding domains, which is half the story. Missing for 10: documented domain-exclusion parameter, a full parameter reference for the domain filters, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can restrict or exclude specific domains from my search results

citations.quote: Set it to "prefer" to also search the rest of the web, so results outside `include_domains` can still surface, or "restrict" to keep the existing hard-filter behavior.
Set it to "prefer" to also search the rest of the web, so results outside include_domains can still surface
